err_apply_failed: Failed to apply the DNS settings
err_not_authorized: NetworkManager refused the change (not authorized). Set the Privilege command setting to 'pkexec' or 'sudo -n'.
err_timeout: Timed out applying the DNS change (authorization prompt left unanswered?)

custom_servers.description: One DNS server per row, written 'Name = address'. One or two IPv4 addresses per row, e.g. 'Pi-hole = 192.168.1.5' or 'NextDNS = 45.90.28.0 45.90.30.0'. Rows appear in the panel in the order you list them; invalid ones are skipped.
custom_servers.label: Custom servers

poll_seconds.description: How often the active DNS is re-read with nmcli.
poll_seconds.label: Poll interval (seconds)

privilege_command.description: Prefix to run nmcli changes as root (e.g. 'pkexec', 'sudo -n'). Empty (default) runs nmcli directly — NetworkManager's polkit policy allows this for active local sessions on most desktop distros.
privilege_command.label: Privilege command

providers.description: Comma-separated ids included in the click cycle: google, cloudflare, opendns, adguard, quad9. Empty = none (custom servers and ISP default only).
providers.label: Built-in providers

show_label.description: Show the provider name next to the glyph (off = glyph only).
show_label.label: Show provider name

title: DNS Switcher
tooltip_hints: click: panel · right: reset to ISP
tooltip_switching: Applying the DNS change — a password prompt may appear
